data.title: Casa Serene
data.about:
Explore Casa Serene Villas by Grid Properties, an epitome of elite sophistication. Dive into an ensemble of four bespoke 5 to 6-bedroom villas, each a hidden gem amidst nature's embrace. 

Located on the edge of the vibrant Dubai, yet cocooned in discretion and privacy. Envision an extension of Downtown's elegance—a lush escape in the midst of the metropolis, all securely set within Sobha Hartland in Mohammed Bin Rashed Al Maktoum City. Here, contemporary design meets unmatched craftsmanship, creating a villa collection that elevates everyday living.

location_tile.title: Conveniently located in MBR City, Dubai
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Located in the prestigious MBR City and cradled within the Sobha Hartland enclave, Casa Serene stands as both a haven and a gateway. While it's a stone's throw from the city's shimmer, its strategic placement ensures utmost discretion. Casa Serene truly strikes the ideal equilibrium.

  • 07 mins Meydan - Golf and Track
  • 10 mins Downtown Dubai / Dubai Mall
  • 12 mins Business Bay
  • 12 mins Dubai Hills
  • 12 mins Jumeirah
  • 13 mins Dubai International Financial Centre
